newsitem.title: HUNGARY: OTP rises in upbeat Budapest market.
newsitem.headline: OTP rises in upbeat Budapest market.

text.p: An almost three percent rise in shares of OTP Bank on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Friday was due to a general positive feeling in the market, a trader said.
"The forint is stronger, every other outside factor is also positive, the market has obviously decided to go up," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings.
He added that Friday's newspaper report that OTP's 1996 pre-tax profit was up 45 percent on 1995 had little impact on the share price.
At 1119 GMT, OTP shares stood at 3,400 forints, up 95.
